Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for harming the integrity of your working device, GFT & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, such as changing system settings, installing system-level software or stealing confidential information, like passwords.

reference_reply:
Below you will find the additional form information for that request and the information you filled out.

- Need: Extra information needed to request admin rights on the computer
- Do you need admin rights for one-time action / software installation?: No I need those rights every week for running and installing software.
- Do you need temporary short or long term admin rights?: Long Term: Choose this if you need to regularly execute administrative tasks (justification required)
- General Instructions:
Please provide the full name of your GBL employee manager (L6 or above). If they are unavailable, please provide an alternative contact to complete this request.

NOTE: If you are L6 and above, you don't need a manager approval. Therefore please add your own name as the approver.

The field below only accept persons with Level L6 and above
- Project Manager Full name: Mario Ricci (Rome) (MARI)
- Computer name information:
Below you will find the computers Group IT has already assigned to you, the available names may not match the one on the label of your PC.

To identify your computer name pls check the Device Name in the company portal application or open a cmd command window and write hostname.

If your PC is not in the list, please ensure to select Not in the list (PC) and place the name of your computer in the Other Computer Name field, in that case, ensure to fill that field.
- Computer Name: GBL-abCdEfGhIjK (PC)
- Other Computer name:
- Computer System: Windows
- Additional information:
Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harming integrity of your working device, GBL & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, as changing system settings, installing system-level software or steal confidential information, like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested, if you need it for regular repeating tasks for daily business (please provide reason in ticket request, it will not approved without proper justification).
Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Some clients requirements demands us to not work with local admin rights, it is highly important that you check prior with your manager that you do not violate client contract by your request.
- List clients and projects you work on.:
Company A Liquido
- Justification, including the list of software/actions that requires you to have admin Rights:
I need to install some applications like Oracle DB.
- Important Information:
The provided local admin rights will require to be renewed after 12 Months after the approval. A new request will be required at that time if those rights are still needed.
- GBL Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base GBL Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the GBL Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from GBL Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GBL Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GBL Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GBL Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://example.com) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base GBL Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by the GBL/IT Infrastructure Department with the exception of trial software that should only be used for evaluation purposes

- You are also responsible for providing a patch management process for the software that you additionally installed (with special attention to security patches)
- As a holder of LAR privileges

baseline.answer:
Hello,

To request administrator rights, please provide the following information:

- **Access duration:** temporary/short-term or long-term. Long-term access requires justification for recurring business activities.
- **GFT employee manager/approver:** full name of an L6-or-above manager. If you are L6 or above, provide your own name.
- **Computer name:** find it in the Company Portal under **Device name**, or open Command Prompt and run `hostname`.
- **Operating system:** for example, Windows.
- **Client/project:** where the access is required.
- **Detailed justification:** specify the Oracle application/components to be installed or run and why administrator rights are required.

Please also confirm with your manager that local administrator rights are permitted under the applicable client requirements. Rights are limited to approved software and must be renewed after 12 months.

If Oracle is a **one-time installation**, please use the **Windows Software Installation – I need software or a license installed on my computer** service instead; Group IT should perform the installation without granting permanent administrator rights.

Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base ABC Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the ABC Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from ABC Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of ABC Group is eligible and may be installed.

✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between ABC Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a ABC Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base ABC Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by the ABC/IT Infrastructure Department with the exception of trial software that should only be used for evaluation purposes

- You are also responsible for providing a patch management

✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base GFB Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by the GFB/IT Infrastructure Department with the exception of trial software that should only be used for evaluation purposes

Please complete the **Local Administrator Rights request form** so that we can process your request.

Please provide:

- Whether the access is required for a **one-time installation** or **regular/long-term use**
- The **full name of your manager (L6 or above)** for approval

- Your computer name  
  - Check **Device name** in Company Portal, or run `hostname` from Command Prompt
- Operating system
- Client/project(s) concerned
- A clear justification, including the **names of all software and administrative actions** requiring elevated rights

Permanent local administrator access is intended only for recurring business activities and requires appropriate justification; temporary access should be requested for one-time installations where applicable.

Approved access must be renewed after 12 months. Only business-related, appropriately licensed or approved open-source software may be installed, and the workstation’s security controls and base configuration must not be modified.

query_title: I need administration right on my personal computer
reference_reply:
Below you will find the additional form information for that request and the information you filled out.

- Need: Extra information needed to request admin rights on the computer
- Do you need admin rights for one-time action / software installation?: No I need those rights every week for running and installing software.
- Do you need temporary short or long term admin rights?: Long Term: Choose this if you need to regularly execute administrative tasks (justification required)
- General Instructions:
Please provide the full name of your GHT employee manager (L6 or above). If they are unavailable, please provide an alternative contact to complete this request.

NOTE: If you are L6 and above, you don't need a manager approval. Therefore please add your own name as the approver.

The field below only accepts persons with Level L6 and above
- Project Manager Full name: Leonardo di Marco (Verona) (B23C)
- Computer name information:
Below you will find the computers Group IT has already assigned to you, the available names may not match the one on the label of your PC.

To identify your computer name pls check the Device Name in the company portal application or open a cmd command window and write hostname.

If your PC is not in the list, please ensure to select Not in the list (PC) and place the name of your computer in the Other Computer Name field, in that case, ensure to fill that field.
- Computer Name: GHT-x9HsRm3opLQ (PC)
- Other Computer name:
- Computer System: Windows
- Additional information:
Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harming integrity of your working device, GHT & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, as changing system settings, installing system-level software or steal confidential information, like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested, if you need it for regular repeating tasks for daily business (please provide reason in ticket request, it will not approved without proper justification).
Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Some clients requirements demands us to not work with local admin rights, it is highly important that you check prior with your manager that you do not violate client contract by your request.
- List clients and projects you work on.:
BPQR
- Justification, including the list of software/actions that requires you to have admin Rights:
Java JDK
IDE
DB Clients
Customer VPN
- Important Information:
The provided local admin rights will require to be renewed after 12 Months after the approval. A new request will be required at that time if those rights are still needed.
- GHT Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base GHT Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the GHT Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from GHT Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GHT Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GHT Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GHT Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base GHT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by the GHT/IT Infrastructure Department with the exception of trial software that should only be used for evaluation purposes

- You are also responsible for providing a patch management process for the software that you additionally installed (with special attention to security patches)

baseline.answer:
Hello,

Administrator rights cannot be granted directly through this ticket. Please submit the **Local Administration Rights (LAR) request form** and provide the following information:

- Whether the access is required for a one-time installation or recurring work
- Temporary or long-term access (long-term access requires business justification)
- The full name of your manager/approver at level L6 or above  
  - If you are L6 or above, enter your own name as approver
- Computer name/device name and operating system  
  - You can find the device name in the Company Portal or by running `hostname` in Command Prompt
- Clients and projects you support
- The specific software or administrative actions requiring elevated rights, with justification

Please first confirm with your manager that local administrator rights do not conflict with any client requirements. Permanent rights increase security risk and are only approved for recurring business needs with sufficient justification. Rights, if approved, must be renewed after 12 months.

Only authorized, business-related software may be installed, in accordance with the XYZ Local Admin Rights Policy.

Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

? Alter the base GFT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.

Approved rights must be renewed after **12 months**, if they are still required.

✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base LTA Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e. viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by the LTA/IT Infrastructure Department with the exception of trial software that should only be used for evaluation purposes

baseline.answer:
Please submit a **Local Administrator Rights** request using the appropriate request form.

Based on your description, select **Long Term** if you need to regularly update your IDE and modify environment variables. Please include:

- Your manager’s full name (L6 or above) for approval; if you are L6 or above, provide your own name.
- Your computer name. You can find it in the Company Portal under **Device Name**, or by running `hostname` from Command Prompt.
- Your operating system.
- The project/client you support.
- A detailed justification, including the IDE and the administrative actions required.

Please confirm with your manager that local administrator rights do not conflict with any client requirements. Permanent local admin access is intended only for recurring business activities, must be renewed after 12 months, and may be used only for approved business-related software. If this is only a one-time IDE installation or update, use the **Windows Software Installation** service instead.

Hello,

Please submit a **Local Administrator Rights** request using the appropriate IT request form. To process it, please provide:

- Whether the access is needed for a **one-time installation** or **regular/long-term development activities**
- Your manager’s full name (**L6 or above**) for approval; if you are L6 or above, provide your own name as approver
